 See what the stars have in store for your sign By Snehaa Khanna Sahgal 2 November 2026 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) You have the owl spirit animal looking out for you this week, Cancer . Think wisdom, transformation, unique perspective, and so much more. You have looked at things long and hard, and now you know what exactly you are working towards. Now don't give up this resilient, silent fight. Explore new worlds and make sure you are doing this from an elevated long-term perspective. Results are guaranteed.
 Cosmic tip: Observe, assimilate and act.
